A closer look

FULL-STACK STARTER KIT
01 /

Three surfaces. One foundation.

A modular Go API, a server-rendered Next.js customer app, and a Vite Admin Console communicate through shared HTTP contracts.

02 /

Start small. Add what you need.

Accounts, API keys, and audit come by default. Enable organizations, permissions, notifications, private assets, usage, settings, or webhooks as needed.

03 /

Own your starting point.

Initialize a downstream project with your own name and module path. Install source-based plugins, themes, and blocks as your application grows.

GET STARTED

Make it your starting point.

Clone the starter and follow the repository quick start to configure your project. The docs cover initialization, local development, and deployment.

TERMINAL
git clone https://github.com/fastagi/fastbuild.git
cd fastbuild
# Follow README.md to initialize your project

Prerequisites: Docker Compose, Go, Node.js, and Corepack. Check the README for current supported versions before running.

A few useful details.

Is this a finished SaaS application?

FastBuild is a full-stack starter kit. It provides reusable foundations and optional business starters; your application supplies the product-specific workflows.

Can I use just one frontend?

Yes. The customer Web application and Admin Console are independently deployable. A downstream application can use either or both.

What is included in the license?

The FastBuild repository is published under the MIT license. Consult its LICENSE file and retain applicable copyright and license notices when distributing copies.
